name: The Garage
tradition: The Eleven-String Feedback now opens every Grunge home game: eleven guitars line the tunnel, each one sustains a note for a starter, and the final feedback wave tells The Mosh Pit the first defensive stand is already plugged in.

cue.label: Eleven-String Feedback
cue.pregameLine: The tunnel guitars are sustaining all eleven notes, and The Garage is waiting for the feedback wave to break.
cue.crowdResponse: The Mosh Pit answers with a LOUD-ER! THAN! LOVE! call that rattles the visiting snap count.
